releases.body:
## Highlights
- add compatibility for both legacy and newer OpenCode permission request events
- handle permission reply events to clear waiting state more accurately
- improve permission notification messages for read, edit, bash, and external directory access
- document permission-event support in the README

## Upgrade
`opencode plugin opencode-moshi-live --global`

If already installed, restart OpenCode to pick up the latest plugin version.

## Notes
- npm package: `opencode-moshi-live@0.1.1`
- continues to require Bun at runtime

## Highlights
- Add OpenCode plugin for Moshi Live Activity and notification updates
- Distinguish task completion from reply-needed and permission-needed states
- Add CLI helper commands for setup, uninstall, and Moshi token management
- Document security considerations and publish workflow

## Install
`opencode plugin opencode-moshi-live --global`

Then set your Moshi token:
`bunx opencode-moshi-live token YOUR_TOKEN_HERE`

## Notes
- Requires Bun at runtime
- Sends normalized OpenCode event metadata to the Moshi API
